APPROVE. The extracted helpers copy the original logic verbatim, and the lazy `Where(reported.Add(...))` in the `foreach` is equivalent to the old `if (!reported.Add(...)) continue;`. That filter runs once per element in order, so behaviour is unchanged. Removing the nested loops, ifs and the `continue` should bring the method's complexity to roughly 13, under the 15 limit.

I could not build the project or see the rest of the file, so the parameter types (`CiChangeFilter`, `TestInvocation`, `List<string> missed`) are unchecked. I'm assuming they match the existing types.
